name: Copart
description: Copart runs online vehicle auctions, mainly for wrecked and total-loss cars, taking a fee from the seller (mostly insurance companies: 79 percent of vehicles processed in FY2026) and from buyers (dismantlers, rebuilders, dealers, exporters). It operates 286 facilities to store vehicles and earns fees per car sold, with a smaller line buying and reselling vehicles. The business is asset-heavy (yards) but high margin: 35.4 percent operating margin in FY2026.

employees.note: Full and part-time; about 7,400 in the US and about 4,600 in the International segment.

businessLines.name: United States segment
businessLines.how: Auction and related fees per vehicle sold (percentage of sale price, tiered or fixed fees) plus buyer fees, storage and transport; US service revenue fell 1.8% as FY2025 included one-time hurricane revenue.

businessLines.name: International segment
businessLines.how: Same auction fee model in Canada, the UK, Brazil, Ireland, Germany, Finland, the UAE, Oman, Bahrain and Spain, with a larger share of vehicles bought and resold (vehicle sales $277.5M).
